data.description:
## Goal

Fix the runaway triage retry loop in the audit runner's F3 full-suite auto-execution so an audit never hangs and always completes (or fails cleanly).

Discovered while auditing SA-0MUM5UWL4005YH0X (discovered-from:SA-0MUM5UWL4005YH0X). Blocks re-audit of that item per operator decision.

## Failure Signature

During `audit_runner.py issue SA-0MUM5UWL4005YH0X` F3 auto-execution (`_run_tests_via_test_skill`), the runner repeatedly invoked the triage helper for the SAME failing test:

- Work item: SA-0MUM5UWL4005YH0X
- HEAD: 95184f21c18808564ddb515e8a0edd798537d3d6
- Test name triaged: skill/audit/tests/test_audit_execute.py::TestGateNeverBlocksOnCacheMiss::test_cache_miss_proceeds_to_phase1
- Observed: 170+ `triage.issue.blocking_child` events in ~15 min, each failing `wl dep add SA-0MUM5UWL4005YH0X SA-0MUMAOPTU009L2MU` (exit 1).
- The runner process consumed ~1s CPU and emitted ~6 KB/min of the same repeating records; it never printed its completion line and never returned. It was killed per the monitored-run abort contract.

## Evidence

- Run log: ~/.audit_debug/SorraAgents/SA-0MUM5UWL4005YH0X-20260929-071920.log
- The repeated pair is:
  - `{"event": "triage.issue.blocking_child", "issueId": "SA-0MUMAOPTU009L2MU", "parentWorkItemId": "SA-0MUM5UWL4005YH0X", "heuristic": "token_overlap_stacktrace"}` (alternating with `commit_or_ci_url`)
  - `[triage] wl command failed: wl dep add SA-0MUM5UWL4005YH0X SA-0MUMAOPTU009L2MU --json: ... returned non-zero exit status 1.`
- `parse_pytest_failures` (skill/test/scripts/run_tests.py) returns one record per `FAILED`/`ERROR` summary match (`_RED_SUMMARY_RE`), and `_run_tests_via_test_skill` (skill/audit/scripts/audit_runner.py) triages every record in an unbounded `for failure in failures:` loop with no dedup and no cap. Under host contention the captured pytest output contained many duplicate/ambiguous summary-shaped lines for one test, producing a huge `failures` list and thus the runaway loop.

## Root Cause (hypothesis)

`_run_tests_via_test_skill` triages N failure records with no de-duplication by test identity and no upper bound. When the parsed output over-produces records for a single failing test (observed under concurrent full-suite runs / shared test semaphore), the triage call count grows without bound and the audit appears hung.

## Acceptance Criteria

1. `_run_tests_via_test_skill` de-duplicates triage by test identity so `check_or_create` is called at most once per distinct failing test per run.
2. Triage count is bounded (hard cap) and the function always reaches its completion print/return regardless of individual `check_or_create`/`wl dep add` failures.
3. A regression test reproduces the over-production condition (a pytest-output fixture with repeated/ambiguous FAILED summary lines for one test) and asserts a bounded number of `check_or_create` calls.
4. Full project test suite passes.
data.title: [bug] audit_runner F3 auto-execution enters runaway triage retry loop
